scope: Primary terrain cloud receiver planet-occlusion boundary only; no authoritative terrain, erosion, physics, vegetation or graphics-setting changes.
root_cause: Generated datum-clamped terrain has chord-meshed interiors, while camera-relative fragments are reconstructed as planetary f32 positions for cloud queries. The generic strict interior predicate can classify daylight sea receivers as inside the planet and return zero before integrating weather. Atlas disable does not disable the separate cloud receiver gate.
fix: Only the shared primary terrain hook uses cloud_terrain_sun_visibility: h=max(length(origin)-radius,0), b=dot(origin,unit_sun); block iff b<0 and b*b>h*(2*radius+h). Disabled early returns, original cloud-column origin/integration/weather, and generic strict mesh/volume helpers remain unchanged. No arbitrary altitude bias or geometry movement.
hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Vulkan, radv Mesa 26.2.5-arch1.1; Linux x86-64

before.result: Expected failure: daylight 3732/4225 covered ROI pixels differ beyond tolerance; maximum RGB difference 128/255 versus allowed 1/255. Genuine sloped night-side occultation test passed.

cache_cleaned_after.result: 2 actual-renderer tests + 1 shared-WGSL compute test passed; daylight changed pixels 0/4225 and max RGB difference 0; genuine night-side maximum RGB 0. Tangent +/- cases were added subsequently and are included in final gates.

regressions.compute_contract: Four orientations, 11 daylight/interior/chord/limb cases with independent f64 closest-point oracle; exact axis datum tangent and +/-0.001 slope perturbations; generic underground rejection; disabled flags; nonzero weather vs independent Simpson integration and safe >1km rebase. Visibility tolerance 1e-5; optical/rebase 0.002.
regressions.invalid_attempts_retained: regression-after.log reused the stale baseline shader after switching worktrees with a shared Cargo target. compute-first.log exposed the absent helper. cargo clean -p thessa-render-wgpu then rebuilding restored correct source execution; these stale runs are not passes. First final-gate Clippy attempt in gates/clippy.log caught test-only chunks_exact_to_as_chunks; fixed with as_chunks before the final retry.
